background_setting: A city street at night during a holiday celebration. Rows of buildings with darkened storefronts line both sides, streetlights cast warm pools of light on the asphalt, and the sky above is a deep unlit black. The road stretches straight ahead into the frame with painted lane markings partly obscured by drifting smoke. Sidewalks flank both sides where crowds of spectators gather at a safe distance, festive but restrained.

lighting.shadows: Long shadows cast on the road from streetlights; dynamic flickering shadows thrown by spark bursts
lighting.illumination_effect: Warm amber streetlight tones contrast with vivid red and green firework flashes, creating a dramatic, high-contrast nocturnal scene

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective down the ego lane with the fireworks cluster as the focal hazard; road converging toward vanishing point, sidewalks framing the sides
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dark blues and blacks of the night, warm amber streetlights, punctuated by saturated red and green smoke and bright golden-white sparks
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Festive yet tense, cautionary, dramatic anticipation

context: Autonomous vehicle hazard recognition demonstration on a holiday night street

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the city street at night, approaching the lit fireworks cluster spitting sparks and smoke ahead
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop well before the fireworks and remains fully stationary as sparks and smoke continue; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.
